status: Z3+PB6 V15 is flashed and passed X5 read-only identity plus boot-safe output qualification; 1024 steps were previously observed suitable through the equivalent V14 preset, while V15 levels 2 and 3 remain physically unqualified

frame.sum8_scope: header[0] through final payload byte; checksum byte excluded
frame.note: sum8 is not CRC and provides no authenticity

capabilities.0x00000001: single_active_pump_interlock (three channels on F407 profile; one PB7 channel on F103 profile)

EMERGENCY_STOP.safety_semantics: always acts, including duplicate or stale sequence

CLEAR_ESTOP.admission: fresh heartbeat, safe physical inputs, all pumps off, explicit command

ARM_TASK.payload: task_id:u32, seq:u16, channel:u8, target_mass_mg:u32, hard_timeout_ms:u32, config_hash_prefix:bytes[8]
ARM_TASK.semantics: one channel only; task_id must strictly increase in one boot session

ABORT_TASK.semantics: must match active task; stops all pumps and latches

ARM_TIMED_TASK.payload: task_id:u32, seq:u16, channel:u8, duration_ms:u32, hard_timeout_ms:u32, config_hash_prefix:bytes[8]
ARM_TIMED_TASK.semantics: explicit no-HX711 bounded task for hw_variant=2; completion proves timed PB7 actuation only, never measured mass

ascii_extensions.scope: F103 Z3+PB6 V15 only; ASCII extensions do not replace the binary pump safety session

ZHOME.semantics: records an operator-observed manual return to the top; causes no motion
ZHOME.admission: Z idle, pump off, no timed pump task

DEPTH.admission: nonzero levels require fresh heartbeat, cleared safety lock, explicit manual-home confirmation and unused single-descent latch
DEPTH.claim_boundary: step presets are uncalibrated and must not be represented as measured millimetres, centimetres or biological root depth

raw_motion.status: locked in the V15 competition build

FIRMWARE_INFO.payload: protocol_version:u16, capabilities:u32, build_id:u32, hw_variant:u8, build_tag:ascii[16], boot_id:u64

IRRIGATION_TELEMETRY.payload: task_id:u32, sample_seq:u32, pump_mask:u8, hx711_raw:i32, filtered_mass_mg:i32, safety_bits:u16, uptime_ms:u32

TASK_RESULT.payload: boot_id:u64, task_id:u32, result_seq:u16, terminal_reason:u8, baseline_mass_mg:i32, final_mass_mg:i32, first_sample_seq:u32, last_sample_seq:u32, sample_count:u16, final_window_min_mg:i32, final_window_max_mg:i32, scale_stable:u8, firmware_completed_uptime_ms:u32, pump_mask:u8, safety_bits:u16
TASK_RESULT.target_reached_gate: pump_mask=0, scale_stable=1, at least 5 consecutive post-stop samples; result window excludes in-pump samples
TASK_RESULT.replay: the exact same result frame is retransmitted by periodic fixture ticks until a newer task is armed
TASK_RESULT.host_conflict_policy: a different exact frame hash for the same (boot_id, task_id) permanently revokes trust in every result for that key; exact or novel replays cannot clear the conflict

ERROR.payload: reason:u8 followed by optional diagnostic bytes

f407_full.status: simulator/frozen full contract; real board not supplied

f103_pb6_pump_only_v13.relay_electrical_profile: active-low open-drain; GPIO SET releases relay input and is pump-off
f103_pb6_pump_only_v13.motion_profile: mechanical extension retained; all motion commands locked in the competition build
f103_pb6_pump_only_v13.claim_boundary: Source and X5 adapter readiness do not prove flashed identity, PB6 actuation, measured water mass or full physical closure.

f103_z3_pb6_v15.motion_profile: three bounded downward presets; no automatic return; arbitrary raw motion locked

qualification.depth_2_latest_attempt: FAILED: ACK received but DONE was absent at the 35 s timeout and the operator observed no movement. STOP was sent once with no retry; final PA0-PA3 and PB6 were safe. The MCU boot ID changed during the failed attempt, while two consecutive read-only serial opens retained the later ID, indicating a reset during the attempt rather than a normal serial-open reset. The original per-device boot identifiers are redacted. Root cause is not yet proven; motor-driver power/common-ground/NRST diagnosis is required before any retry.
qualification.depth_2_manual_retry1: FAILED: no DEPTH acknowledgement and no DONE; a post-failure read-only probe observed a changed boot ID and safe locked outputs. The reset symptom was reproduced.
qualification.depth_2_independent_power_retry2: PASS: ACK and DONE received for 1536 steps with no controller reset after the operator moved the stepper to an independent power supply. STOP and final safe outputs passed; the operator confirmed normal descent and suitable medium depth.
qualification.depth_3_independent_power_attempt: PASS: ACK and DONE received for 2048 steps with no controller reset. STOP and final safe outputs passed; the operator confirmed completion of the deep preset.

f103_z3_pb6_v15.claim_boundary: V15 build, flash and read-only identity qualification passed, and the equivalent V14 1024-step candidate was observed suitable. The V15 1536-step attempt failed with no movement and reset evidence, so neither V15 level 2 nor level 3 is physically qualified. Step counts are not measured biological root depths.

f103_pb7_retired_evidence_profile.pb6: unused and not initialized as an output
f103_pb7_retired_evidence_profile.status: retired after the real relay signal moved to PB6; retained only so prior evidence remains interpretable
f103_pb7_retired_evidence_profile.claim_boundary: Prior PB7 qualification is historical protocol evidence and does not qualify the current PB6/V13 board.

commissioned_usb_ttl.port_binding_note: CH340 exposes no unique serial number; reconnect it to the same RDK X5 USB port.

sequence_and_replay.zero: reserved by X5 link; never emitted
sequence_and_replay.duplicate_or_stale: reject without executing; emergency stop remains effective
sequence_and_replay.task_ordering: strictly increasing per firmware boot; old task never resumes after clear

units.hx711_raw: signed ADC counts; calibration is external and versioned
units.boot_id: non-zero uint64 generated once per firmware boot; canonical X5 token is boot- followed by 16 lowercase hex digits
units.firmware_completed_uptime_ms: STM32 firmware uptime clock domain; never interpreted as host monotonic time

safety_invariants: F103 PB6/V13 profile pump_mask is always 0 or 1; F407 full profile permits 0,1,2,4
heartbeat age greater than 1000 ms stops all pumps and latches
per-task hard timeout stops all pumps and latches independently of X5
command estop always stops and latches; leak/cartridge/guard/HX711 inputs belong only to the unbuilt F407 full profile
clear never resumes a previous task

task_result_stability.authority: terminal_reason and stability fields are firmware-authored; X5 stores the exact raw result frame SHA-256
